cockpitGovernance.title: Governance health
cockpitGovernance.subtitle: Proof that the agents worked within the rules. Hover each number.

tooltips.receipts: Receipts = auditable records of governed execution. Every time an agent runs a task under the rules, it produces a receipt that proves what was done.
tooltips.conflicts: Conflicts = rules that contradicted each other during execution. The expected value is zero; above zero warrants Bruna's review.
tooltips.truncated: Context cuts = times the material handed to the agent was too large and had to be trimmed. Many cuts can lower work quality.
